format_name: Heroes of Might and Magic III - Shadow of Death / HotA save file (.GM1)
notes: All offsets are RELATIVE TO THE START of the decompressed (gzip) save data.
All offsets are HEX STRINGS (e.g. '0x157EC3') to avoid decimal conversion errors.
All multi-byte integers are LITTLE-ENDIAN unless stated otherwise.
⚠️ IMPORTANT: All concrete offsets below are VALID ONLY for the same map!
Offsets were derived via differential analysis of saves from the map
'Myth and Legend.h3m'. Different maps will have DIFFERENT absolute offsets
because hero/town/object counts differ, which shifts all subsequent data.
Hero blocks have VARIABLE STRIDE — they are scattered across the file.
Town garrison uses 5 slots (not 7 like hero army).
Movement cost: 100 per horizontal/vertical step, 141 per diagonal step.
Movement cost is ALSO modified by: terrain, roads, artifacts, hero class
(native terrain bonus), building bonuses (e.g. Stables).
To find blocks in a NEW save (different map), use the 'Find Hero Blocks'
feature in the parser GUI, or extend the search_patterns section below.
VISITED OBJECTS BITMASK is spread across MULTIPLE bytes:
0x157F4D bit 4 = Fountain of Fortune (weekly luck)
0x157F4E bit 0 = Upgrade Fort (weekly)
0x157F57 bit 3 = Marletto Tower (permanent +1 defense)
0x157F5F bit 5 = Mercenary Camp (permanent +1 attack)
TOWN GARRISON has 7 slots (same as heroes), NOT 5.
EXPERIENCE is at 0x157F45 (u32 LE), NOT 0x157F04 (which is hero coords).
LEVEL is at 0x157F49 (u8), NOT 0x157F08.
MOVEMENT POINTS (alt hero block) is at 0x157F41 (u32 LE), NOT 0x157F00.
ARENA visited flag: 0x157F6F bit 4 (permanent +2 defense).
ATTACK BONUS COUNTER: 0x15800C (u8, accumulates permanent attack bonuses from objects).
DEFENSE BONUS COUNTER: 0x15800D (u8, accumulates permanent defense bonuses from objects).
HERO BLOCK STRUCTURE verified against h3sed (suurjaak/h3sed).
Hero block start in 'Myth and Legend.h3m' saves: 0x157F1E (faction byte).
ALL hero fields verified: location, movement, exp, level, skills, army, attack/defense/power/knowledge, spells, equipment, inventory.
CORRECTION: 0x157F49 = skills_count (NOT level), 0x157F4F = level (NOT skill_level).
CORRECTION: 0x15800C/D/E/F = attack/defense/power/knowledge (NOT bonus counters).
TOWN BLOCK STRUCTURE verified against h3sed TOWN_BYTE_POSITIONS.
Town faction (owner) = offset 0, changes when captured (e.g. 4=Orange → 3=Green).
Town type = offset 3, does NOT change when captured.
Town has 7 garrison slots (7×u32 types + 7×u32 counts), SAME as heroes.
Town name is cp1251-encoded, variable length (max 14 chars).
VERIFIED: All 4 save editors (h3sed, cysun, vlucas, svetoslav) use identical hero offsets.
cysun/vlucas/svetoslav use hero NAME as base (h3sed offset 169); h3sed uses faction byte (offset 0).
vlucas adds: CoordinatesXMarker (h3sed 19), CoordinatesYMarker (h3sed 23), BlockedSlots (h3sed 1047).
h3sed is the MOST COMPLETE: 35+ fields including town structure, path records, and HotA skills_slot at 1092.
DAY COUNTER found at 0x17F494 (u8). Verified: day 2→3 on end turn.
MOVEMENT RESET confirmed: movement_left resets to movement_total on new day.
NEW: h3sed 'unknown' offsets 1-30 partially decoded:
offset +3 = battle_outcome_flag (253→0 on victory)
offset +4 = artifacts_collected_counter (+1 on pickup)
offset +15 = hero_action_counter (+1 per action)
offset +29 = mana_bonus_or_spellpoints (+2 on level up)
INVENTORY VERIFIED: 64 slots × 8 bytes at offset 534. Artifact ID=22 added to slot 19 in xx_04→xx_05.
COORDINATE ORDER CORRECTED: h3sed labels are X,Y,Z but actual byte order is X,Z,Y.
raw[-26] = X, raw[-25] = Z (0=surface, 1=underground), raw[-24] = Y
Verified: Аламар X=54,Z=0,Y=93; Town Патрас X=40,Z=0,Y=103
MAP-SAVE COORDINATE OFFSET: Save X = Map X - 2 (towns occupy 2x2 tiles, save uses top-left corner).
MAP DATA: 'Myth and Legend.h3m' has 144x144 tiles, underground, 7009 objects, 21 towns.

blocks.name: header
blocks.description: Save file header (magic, version, map name, filename)

fields.name: save_filename
fields.description: Save file name (last 10 chars of filename, ASCII null-terminated)

blocks.name: player_state
blocks.description: Player global state (action flags, resources)

fields.name: last_visited_object_id
fields.description: Last visited object ID / action flag (changes on visit)

blocks.name: enemy_hero_state
blocks.description: Enemy hero state (for tracking defeated/fled enemies)

fields.name: enemy_hero_swap
fields.description: Enemy hero swap field (bytes reorder on defeat)

blocks.name: object_owners
blocks.description: Map object owner array (mines, dwellings, etc.)

fields.name: object_owner_example
fields.description: Example slot of object owner array. Each map object (mine, dwelling) has 1 byte with player color (0-7) or 0xFF=neutral. Stride between objects needs further investigation.

blocks.name: town
blocks.description: Town record — full structure from h3sed TOWN_BYTE_POSITIONS

fields.name: faction
fields.description: Town owner/faction (offset 0). 0-7=player, 0xFF=neutral. Changes when town is captured.

fields.name: type
fields.description: Town type (offset 3). Does NOT change when captured.

fields.name: name
fields.description: Town name (offset 71, variable length, max 14 chars)

blocks.name: town_visiting_hero
blocks.description: Visiting hero coordinates for town

fields.name: visiting_hero_coords
fields.description: Visiting hero coordinates (X, Y) as 2 × u32 LE. (0xFFFFFFFF, 0xFFFFFFFF) = no visitor.

fields.name: visiting_hero_flag
fields.description: Visiting hero flag (true if hero is visiting town)

blocks.name: hero_main_block
blocks.description: HERO block — full structure from h3sed (offsets relative to faction byte at 0x157F1E)

fields.name: location_z
fields.description: Hero Z coordinate (0=overworld, 1=underground). CORRECTED: h3sed labels this as location_y but actual byte order is X, Z, Y.

fields.name: location_y
fields.description: Hero Y coordinate. CORRECTED: h3sed labels this as location_z but actual byte order is X, Z, Y.

fields.name: skill_levels
fields.description: Skill levels (offset 182, 30 bytes for HotA, 28 for SoD)

fields.name: attack
fields.description: Attack stat (offset 238). Includes permanent bonuses from objects.

fields.name: defense
fields.description: Defense stat (offset 239). Includes permanent bonuses from objects.

fields.name: spells_available
fields.description: All spells available for casting (offset 312, 70 bytes bitmask)

fields.name: queued_path_destination
fields.description: Queued path destination (offset 19, in 'unknown' section of h3sed)

fields.name: visited_fountain_fortune
fields.description: Fountain of Fortune visited (bit 4, weekly luck)

fields.name: coordinates_x_marker
fields.description: Coordinates X marker (vlucas offset -150 from name = h3sed offset 19). Possibly queued path X or coord marker.

fields.name: coordinates_y_marker
fields.description: Coordinates Y marker (vlucas offset -146 from name = h3sed offset 23). Possibly queued path Y or coord marker.

fields.name: blocked_slots
fields.description: Blocked slots by combination artifacts (vlucas offset 878 from name = h3sed offset 1047). Note: h3sed has 'reserved' at 1046-1055.

fields.name: battle_outcome_flag
fields.description: Battle outcome flag (h3sed offset +3). 253=before battle, 0=after victory. Verified in xx_01→xx_02 (killed monster).

fields.name: artifacts_collected_counter
fields.description: Artifacts collected counter (h3sed offset +4). +1 when picking up artifact. Verified in xx_04→xx_05.

fields.name: hero_action_counter
fields.description: Hero action counter (h3sed offset +15). +1 per action (move, fight, pickup). Verified across all 4 xx diffs.

fields.name: mana_bonus_or_spellpoints
fields.description: Mana bonus or spell points (h3sed offset +29). +2 on level up. Verified in xx_03→xx_04.

fields.name: inventory_slot_format
fields.description: Inventory: 64 slots × 8 bytes (h3sed offset 534). Each slot = u32 LE artifact_id + u32 LE data. 0xFFFFFFFF = empty. Verified: artifact ID=22 added to slot 19 (offset 686) in xx_04→xx_05.

blocks.name: hero_main_movement_alt
blocks.description: Hero #1 movement bytes (alt block, smaller mirror)

blocks.name: hero_2_block
blocks.description: Hero #2 alt block (stats + visit counter)

fields.name: visit_counter_short
fields.description: Hero #2 short-term visit counter (u32 LE, 0xFFFFFFFF=not visited)

blocks.name: hero_3_block
blocks.description: Hero #3 alt block

blocks.name: hero_4_block
blocks.description: Hero #4 alt block (one of multiple scattered blocks)

fields.name: movement_byte
fields.description: Hero #4 movement byte. NOTE: Hero blocks have variable stride across the file.

blocks.name: hero_5_block
blocks.description: Hero #5 (defender/in boat) block

fields.name: hero_xy
fields.description: Hero #5 X,Y coordinates (UTF-16 LE, in boat)

blocks.name: hero_alt_block_general
blocks.description: Hero alt block fields (multiple heroes share these offsets in different blocks)

fields.name: hero_on_boat_flag
fields.description: Hero on boat flag (0x22=on boat/water, 0x08=on land)

fields.name: map_object_visiting_coords
fields.description: Map object visiting coords (2 × u32 LE). Set when hero visits fort/shrine/etc.

fields.name: hero_level_alt
fields.description: Hero level (alt block). +2 after winning a battle.

fields.name: hero_artifact_slot_defender
fields.description: Hero artifact slot (defender side). Cleared after defeat.

fields.name: army_count_slot_alt
fields.description: Army count slot (alt block, u32 count + u8 slot_index)

fields.name: skill_count_alt
fields.description: Skill count (alt block). +1 when learning new skill.

fields.name: skill_level_alt
fields.description: Skill level (alt, 2 × u8). +1 when improving existing skill.

blocks.name: global_hero_counters
blocks.description: Global hero turn counters (incremented per hero turn)

fields.name: turn_counter_1
fields.description: Global hero turn counter 1 (+1 per turn)

fields.name: turn_counter_2
fields.description: Global hero turn counter 2 (+1 per turn)

blocks.name: enemy_hero_defeated_block
blocks.description: Enemy hero block (large cleared block on defeat)

fields.name: visiting_coords
fields.description: Enemy visiting coords (reset to -1, -1 on defeat)

fields.name: big_block_cleared
fields.description: Enemy hero big block (43 bytes, fully cleared on defeat)

blocks.name: artifacts_transfer
blocks.description: Artifact slots for transfer (winner/loser)

fields.name: artifact_slot_winner
fields.description: Artifact slot (winner side) — receives artifact after victory

fields.name: artifact_slot_loser
fields.description: Artifact slot (loser side) — cleared after defeat

blocks.name: black_market
blocks.description: Black Market artifact slot

fields.name: black_market_artifact
fields.description: Black Market artifact slot (u32 LE artifact ID, 0xFFFFFFFF=empty)

blocks.name: cheater_flag
blocks.description: Cheater flag (set when any cheat code is used)

fields.name: cheater_flag
fields.description: Cheater flag (0=normal, 1=cheated). Set when ANY cheat code is used.

blocks.name: path_block
blocks.description: Path block — replay log of all hero movements

fields.name: base64_metadata
fields.description: Base64 metadata block (changes on every save, ~190 bytes)

fields.name: map_event_counter
fields.description: Map event counter (increments by number of path-records added)

fields.name: path_block_main
fields.description: Path block (history of movements, ~256 bytes base, expands with new records)

fields.name: path_block_extension
fields.description: Path block extension (variable size, fills as new path-records are added)

fields.name: step_n
fields.description: Step number in current multi-step move

08 03.name: battle_outcome_or_army_transfer
08 03.description: Battle outcome (9b compact) OR Army transfer / Disembark (27b with subrecords)

0b 03.name: fog_of_war_update
0b 03.description: Fog of war update — newly visible tiles

fields.name: pairs
fields.description: Array of N (X, Y) coordinate pairs (4 bytes each)

blocks.name: footer
blocks.description: File footer (last 18 bytes)

fields.name: footer_size_or_crc
fields.description: Footer size or CRC (3 bytes, value changes with file size)

blocks.name: game_state
blocks.description: Game global state (day/week/month counters)

fields.name: day_counter
fields.description: Current day counter (1-7 within week). Verified: 2→3 on end turn (312_6→313_1).

hero_blocks.description: Hero blocks have variable stride, use these patterns to find them

patterns.name: hero_coords_pattern
patterns.description: Hero X,Y coords in UTF-16 LE followed by u32 LE counter=1

patterns.name: hero_visit_id_pattern
patterns.description: Common visit_id values (0x2210, 0x2212, 0x2209) appearing in hero blocks

path_records.description: Path records start with flag1 flag2 bytes

known_unknowns: Map terrain (tile data) — not yet localized
Map object positions and states (except owner color at 0x13C850)
Fog of war bit mask (separate from path-records)
AI player state and decision memory
Quest log state (Seer Huts, Border Guards)
Hero biography (variable-length, precedes hero stats in hero block)
Town buildings list (only 'last built' and 'built flag' known)
Hero primary stats (attack/defense/power/knowledge) — partially known from h3sed but not verified in our diffs

save_447_series.description: Offsets observed in 447_1.GM1 / 447_2.GM1 (same map 'Myth and Legend.h3m' but different save point). These are different from hero_main_block offsets in 'blocks' section because absolute offsets shift between saves depending on game state.

fields.name: hero_army_types[5]
fields.description: Hero army creature IDs (5 slots x 4 bytes); 0xFFFFFFFF = empty

fields.name: hero_army_counts[5]
fields.description: Hero army creature counts (5 slots x 4 bytes)

fields.name: hero_backpack_count
fields.description: Number of artifacts in hero backpack

fields.name: hero_doll_slot_N
fields.description: Equipped artifact slot on hero doll (0xFFFFFFFF = empty)

fields.name: hero_backpack_slots
fields.description: Backpack artifact slots: 4-byte artifact_id + 4-byte data per slot. Cascade shift on remove.

fields.name: day_or_step_counter
fields.description: Counter incremented by 1 per user action

fields.name: hero_alt_flag_per_hero
fields.description: Per-hero flag in alt block (0x04 default -> 0x0c after action)

fields.name: mage_guild_level
fields.description: Magic Guild current level (1-5); verified via 447_2->447_3 (Lv2->Lv3)

fields.name: town_build_flag
fields.description: Set to 1 when any build action performed this turn

fields.name: building_bitmask
fields.description: Town building bitmask (4 bytes). byte[3] bits 0-4 = Mage Guild levels (only current level bit set)

fields.name: town_bitmask_byte
fields.description: Secondary town bitmask; bit 2 = Mage Guild Lv3

fields.name: player_resources[7]
fields.description: 7 x 4-byte LE ints: Wood, Mercury, Ore, Sulfur, Crystal, Gems, Gold

fields.name: town_spell_slots
fields.description: Town spell pool (FF=empty); rearranged on Mage Guild upgrade

fields.name: hero_spell_book_bitmask
fields.description: Per-spell 'cast this turn' flag bitmask (bit cleared when spell cast)
